children: Datta Sanjay, an officer serving as President, Capital& Enterprise, reported a sale of common stock on 2026-09-08. The report lists a weighted average selling price of $27.2948 per share for the transactions. The total sale amount reported was $3,166,196 for 116,000 shares sold. Following the reported transaction, Datta Sanjay directly owns 476,578 shares of common stock. Certain of the shares reported as owned are restricted stock units subject to vesting conditions.
